name: TripPlanning_no_va

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about places people want to travel to in the future.

sound_effects_config.default_background: cozy home evening ambiance with faint city sounds

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where roommates talk about places they would love to travel to someday. They share ideas and try to remember all the destinations they discuss.

variations.context: Talking about dream trips and realistic travel goals

setting.relationship_dynamic: Close friends who enjoy daydreaming together
setting.background: They rely on their home assistant to keep track of future travel ideas

scenario_template.topic: Someone talks about a place they recently saw online or heard about
scenario_template.note: Describing why the place sounds appealing. No assistant is present or addressed in this scenario. The people resolve everything between themselves, or leave it unresolved. Never say 'Sigma'.
